more_info.origin: Prepared by purifying kaolinitic clay without calcination. The food-grade specification requires the material to be free of asbestos.
more_info.overview: Aluminium silicate, or kaolin, is purified natural clay containing kaolinite and associated minerals; the specification excludes calcination and requires asbestos-free material. Its anti-caking role is to reduce the tendency of particles in a food powder to stick together. Prepared by purifying kaolinitic clay without calcination. The food-grade specification requires the material to be free of asbestos. The specified material is supplied as white powder or flakes.
more_info.uses:
Examples in the EU food-use list include certain dairy analogues, including beverage whiteners; vegetable oil pan spray.
The entries apply to particular food categories and may limit the amount, the preparation or the way it is used; they do not show how often the additive appears in retail products.
